error.summary: The exact five-question batch admits a 5/5 incidental shortcut. This is a batch-selection defect; the broader generator supports valid counterexamples. Source replay, mathematics, grading, rendering, scope and packaging checks passed.

source_analysis.skill: Normalize the first pivot, eliminate the lower-left entry, normalize the second pivot, and optionally back-substitute to solve the represented 2x2 system.
reasoning_steps: Normalize and eliminate using elementary row operations.
For solve prompts, back-substitute and select the matching matrix and solution.
invariants: Nonsingular 2x2 coefficient matrix with nonzero first pivot.
Preserve the observed forward-elimination stages and arithmetic difficulty.
permitted_variations: Vary coefficients and constants within the observed workload.
Vary which candidate qualifies and its displayed position.
Derive prompts, solutions and grading consistently from changed evidence.

source_replay.details: Ten complete source banks replay exactly. The known REF/RREF ambiguity is confirmed and corrected in normal generation. Two incomplete captures remain explicitly unsupported.

math.details: Exact independent checks passed for 81 raw and 70 post-delivery records, including intermediate matrices, unique correct choices and optional solutions.

variety.details: The catalogs retain all five target ranks per profile. However, three runner records are scaled q-73439 variants, all with the minimum candidate value correct.

scope.details: Generated cases preserve the observed operators, representations, response contracts and reasoning stages.

grading.details: The native grader passed 755 submissions: 151 accepted and 604 rejected. All fields are radio; free-entry equivalence is inapplicable.

rendering.details: Thirteen records rendered through the actual UI. Inspected screenshots show readable matrices, fractions, controls and worked solutions.

packaging.details: Relocation, deterministic replay, exact requested counts, finite-limit rejection and installed dependencies passed. Both retained CLI defects reproduce on failing artifacts and are fixed currently. Package files remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: A first-pivot/candidate-rank strategy answers all five delivered records without elimination. Controlled target changes break the strategy, establishing a batch-specific incidental cue. All five records survive delivery. Three stored legacy generated records were separately reproduced with demonstrated historical shortcuts.

findings.description: At seed 4258185931, choose the second-largest candidate lower-right value when input a11=1; otherwise choose the smallest. This answers all five delivered questions. Within q-73439, scales 2, 4 and 5 all select the minimum value, succeeding 3/3 versus a 1/5 guessing baseline. The finding concerns this exact batch, not every generator output.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B reproduce_batch_shortcut.py. It reproduces current batch('easy',5,4258185931), reports 5/5 and exits 1. Repeat with --input delivery-batch/accepted.json. Minimal repeated-role pair: ['q-73439',2,0] and ['q-73439',4,0]. The first input is [[3,9,12],[2,7,6]], with correct REF [[1,3,4],[0,1,-2]] and solution x=10,y=-2.
findings.requested_change: Revise batch selection so repeated scaled members of a recognizable coefficient family do not preserve a fixed answer rank or this pivot/rank cue. Use the supported target roles, regenerate the five-item batch, and rerun the retained strict test on its actual delivered records. Preserve source families and the response contract.
